testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect project information from the template chooser: tmp/obk-project-refresh/features/application/project-dialog/project-dialog.feature:6:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect project information from the template chooser ✔ Given the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And a project is active ✔ And a template is selected with its details displayed ✔ When the user chooses Projects in the chooser ✔ Then a Projects dialog opens above the chooser ✔ And the dialog lists project names and locations ✔ And the active project is marked ✔ And the dialog displays a project settings tree ✔ And New, Browse, Save, Apply and Done controls are displayed ✔ When the user chooses Done without changing the project ✔ Then the Projects dialog closes ✔ And the template chooser is displayed again ✔ And the selected template details remain displayed
